top_signals.title: AI Trade Stumbles Again as Investors Rediscover Treasury Haven
top_signals.summary: According to the president of Blackstone Inc., there’s no bubble in artificial intelligence. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent isn’t seeing a “systemic problem” in the boom. But as hard as Wall Street brass works to tamp down concerns around the space, markets are refusing to be calmed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Are Record Short Natural Gas on Mild Winter Outlook
top_signals.summary: Hedge-fund managers have amassed a record short position in US natural gas on expectations for an unusually mild northern winter that points to anemic demand for the furnace and power-plant fuel.

top_signals.title: Abandoned Popcorn Time app exposed millions of device to RCE attacks
top_signals.summary: Researchers remotely disabled a vulnerable updater in the abandoned Time4Popcorn app, a fork of the Popcorn Time BitTorrent client, closing a security flaw that could have allowed attackers to execute malicious code with elevated privileges on millions of computers. [...]
